purpose: Decisive pre-GPU audit of the Stage-C n=4 all-branch LOO estimator against exact finite-policy ground truth.

included: all eight restricted deterministic credit probes
exact enumeration of Q(s,a) over fixed exogenous seeds
gradient cosine, advantage rank correlation, sign accuracy, and RMSE
excluded: general Python or unrestricted RLM transfer

decision_rule.pass: All frozen thresholds pass. Proceed to the preregistered 4B LoRA smoke after the Prime frozen-batch integration checks pass.
decision_rule.fail: Do not provision paid compute. Debug the estimator or probe definition and preregister a new campaign.
decision_rule.zero_signal_handling: A probe with an exactly zero policy gradient is excluded from cosine and rank minima; sign accuracy is one only when there are no above-noise comparisons.
